summary: This is a routine Form 6-K filing by Pony AI Inc., a foreign private issuer, announcing the filing of its annual report on Form 20-F for the fiscal year ended December 31, 2025, and the publication of its inaugural environmental, social and governance (ESG) report. The filing contains no special-situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC activity, or management change. It is purely a periodic regulatory update and ESG disclosure.
